# The Epoch Times

> The Epoch Times is an independent news organization providing breaking news, investigative reporting, and commentary on politics, world events, China, business, and culture with a focus on stories underreported by mainstream media.

The Epoch Times operates a comprehensive digital news platform with regional editions (US, Canada, UK-Europe, Australia), specialized content verticals, and multimedia offerings including EpochTV, podcasts, and games. The publication emphasizes coverage of geopolitical tensions, human rights issues, and economic developments with particular attention to US-China relations and international affairs.

## Key Topics

- Breaking News
- Trump Administration
- China
- Iran
- Geopolitics
- International Relations
- US Politics
- Economy

- Military Operations
- Technology

## Breaking News & Regional Coverage

- [The Epoch Times | Breaking News, Latest News, World News and Videos](https://www.theepochtimes.com): Homepage featuring breaking news, world events, politics, and culture coverage
- [US News: Breaking Headlines and Analysis](https://www.theepochtimes.com/us): US breaking news on politics, government, economy, and legal cases
- [World news | Breaking international news](https://www.theepochtimes.com/world): Global news hub covering Africa, Asia-Pacific, Europe, Latin America, Middle East
- [China News: Stay Informed with The Epoch Times](https://www.theepochtimes.com/china): China news on CCP, human rights, organ harvesting, military, and business
- [Canada News, Opinion, and Analysis](https://www.theepochtimes.com/canada): Canada-focused news and analysis on politics, economy, and China relations
- [Australia breaking News, Opinion, and Analysis](https://www.theepochtimes.com/australia): Australia news covering geopolitics, Iran operations, and energy crisis
- [Latest News and Updates from the UK and Europe](https://www.theepochtimes.com/uk-europe): UK and Europe news aggregation on politics, military, and Iran operations
